note: AD Connector proxies to on-prem AD; no sync, no federation infrastructure.
IAM SAML providers are per account and cannot be referenced across accounts, so D is invalid.
Slight uncertainty about exact IAM Identity Center behaviour with trusted forests, but C is the only workable option (AD Connector supports one domain; Simple AD cannot be an identity source).
Assumes a trust is the intended way to avoid copying accounts, with RDS for SQL Server requiring Managed AD.
Identity sources are Identity Center directory, Active Directory (Managed AD or AD Connector) and external IdP; Simple AD is not supported.
Assumes AD Connector seamless domain join to on-prem domain is the intended simplest answer; in practice domain join straight to on-prem over VPN also works.
